content.comment_body: I am trying to set up an MQTT connection from my [company_name] [product_name] using [product_name] [version_no] to a Zoho IoT device with valid credentials (username, password, TLS settings). However, I keep seeing a 'Failed to parse' error whenever I attempt to connect to Zoho’s MQTT broker. If I use the same configuration to connect to a local Mosquitto MQTT broker, it works perfectly—so the essential MQTT setup on my device is fine. I'm unclear what specifically prevents the connection to Zoho’s broker. Could the issue be: • MQTT protocol version compatibility? • TLS/CA certificate or handshake mismatch? • Different authentication methods? • DNS or hostname resolution on [product_name]? • Or do I need to use an MQTT bridge, like Node-RED, to mediate between my [product_name] and Zoho? Any troubleshooting advice or workarounds would be helpful.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is experiencing persistent failures connecting a [company_name] [product_name] to a Zoho IoT device via MQTT, despite successful connection to a local Mosquitto broker using the same setup. This suggests reliable basic MQTT functionality, but possible compatibility issues with third-party platform authentication, TLS, or protocol support within the PLC software, leaving users uncertain about how to resolve integration barriers.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects straightforward MQTT connectivity between [product_name] and Zoho IoT device, supporting standard protocols and security such as authentication and TLS. There is also an expectation for detailed diagnostics and actionable troubleshooting guidance for resolving connectivity problems with third-party IoT platforms.
